title: Table Profile
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Columns
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'dash_demo' AND table_name = 'support_tickets'

kpis.label: Bars in the distribution chart
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (WITH v AS ( SELECT CAST(priority AS VARCHAR) AS txt, TRY_CAST(CAST(priority AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS num FROM dash_demo.support_tickets ), shape AS ( SELECT count(txt) AS filled, count(num) AS numeric_rows, count(DISTINCT txt) AS distinct_values, min(num) AS lo, max(num) AS hi FROM v ), bucketed AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN s.numeric_rows = s.filled AND s.distinct_values > 20 THEN least(19, CAST(floor((v.num - s.lo) / nullif(s.hi - s.lo, 0) * 20) AS INTEGER)) END AS bin, v.txt AS txt, v.num AS num, s.lo AS lo, s.hi AS hi FROM v, shape s WHERE v.txt IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CASE WHEN b.bin IS NULL THEN b.txt ELSE printf('%.2f - %.2f', b.lo + (b.hi - b.lo) * b.bin / 20.0, b.lo + (b.hi - b.lo) * (b.bin + 1) / 20.0) END AS bucket, count(*) AS rows_in_bucket FROM bucketed b GROUP BY bucket, b.bin ORDER BY b.bin NULLS LAST, rows_in_bucket DESC, bucket LIMIT 20)

kpis.label: The tallest bar of the distribution chart
kpis.sql: SELECT bucket FROM (WITH v AS ( SELECT CAST(priority AS VARCHAR) AS txt, TRY_CAST(CAST(priority AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS num FROM dash_demo.support_tickets ), shape AS ( SELECT count(txt) AS filled, count(num) AS numeric_rows, count(DISTINCT txt) AS distinct_values, min(num) AS lo, max(num) AS hi FROM v ), bucketed AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN s.numeric_rows = s.filled AND s.distinct_values > 20 THEN least(19, CAST(floor((v.num - s.lo) / nullif(s.hi - s.lo, 0) * 20) AS INTEGER)) END AS bin, v.txt AS txt, v.num AS num, s.lo AS lo, s.hi AS hi FROM v, shape s WHERE v.txt IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CASE WHEN b.bin IS NULL THEN b.txt ELSE printf('%.2f - %.2f', b.lo + (b.hi - b.lo) * b.bin / 20.0, b.lo + (b.hi - b.lo) * (b.bin + 1) / 20.0) END AS bucket, count(*) AS rows_in_bucket FROM bucketed b GROUP BY bucket, b.bin ORDER BY b.bin NULLS LAST, rows_in_bucket DESC, bucket LIMIT 20) ORDER BY rows_in_bucket DESC, bucket LIMIT 1
